parameter.name: ip
parameter.label: IP Address
parameter.description: The Hostname or IP address of the device

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port
parameter.description: The TCP port of the gateway (not used by HTTP_ECOWITT, which always uses port 80)

parameter.name: protocol
parameter.label: Protocol
parameter.description: The protocol to use for communicating with the gateway. `DEFAULT` and `ELV` use the TCP binary protocol; `HTTP_ECOWITT` uses the Ecowitt HTTP API (auto-selected during discovery when the gateway supports it).

parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: Polling interval for refreshing the data in seconds

parameter.name: discoverInterval
parameter.label: Discover Interval
parameter.description: Interval in seconds to fetch registered sensors, battery status and signal strength

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.label: Timeout
parameter.description: Time in seconds to wait for the gateway to accept a connection or answer a request. Increase it if the gateway is connected via a slow Wi-Fi link.

parameter.name: failedPollsUntilOffline
parameter.label: Failed Polls Until Offline
parameter.description: Number of consecutive failed polls after which the gateway is reported offline and its values are set to undefined. Until then, the last values are kept.
